# BILL-OTHER for 100.00 USD, posted to `Liabilities:Other Payables`, a plain
# `type: Liability` account rather than a payable, and a wire that already
# took 100.00 USD out of `Assets:Bank:USD` against that liability. Both of the
# wire's splits read "Wire out", and the bill's payment block states the wire
# and its liability split with the same memo.
#
# What this fixture produces: BILL-OTHER settled by the liability split, both
# splits still reading "Wire out". Read again with the block's memo corrected,
# both splits take the correction, as they do on a bill posted to a payable.
#
# Load after `fx_usd_bill_cad_expense.txt`, with
# `--fx-rates tests/fixtures/fx_rates_usd_dated.yaml`.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_corrected_payment_memo_reaches_the_bank_split_on_a_bill_posted_to_a_plain_liability.py.
2026-01-01 open Liabilities:Other Payables
	type: Liability
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"

2026-03-30 * "Wire to US Vendor"
	guid: "0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b1b"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		memo: "Wire out"
	Liabilities:Other Payables 100.00 USD
		guid: "2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		memo: "Wire out"

bill "BILL-OTHER"
	vendor_id: "V-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Parts"
		account: "Expenses:Supplies"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ap_account: "Liabilities:Other Payables"
		memo: "Bill BILL-OTHER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-03-30
		amount: 100
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		txn_guid: "0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a"
		txn_split_guid: "2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c2c"
		memo: "Wire out"
